During routine monitoring, a potential vulnerability in the configuration of API interfaces was identified. To ensure user data security and prevent unauthorized access, the hosting provider's protection algorithms initiated an emergency freeze of the server core. We conducted a full audit of security protocols, after which system operation was restored to normal mode
